value: Which certification level does Form 13614-C give Social Security benefits?
reason: The card called railroad retirement benefits Basic, but the Publication 4012 scope chart requires Advanced for Form RRB-1099.
Limit the level to Social Security benefits, where the intake sheet and the scope chart agree.

value: The same line codes railroad retirement benefits (B), but Publication 4012's scope chart requires Advanced for Form RRB-1099, so check the chart for those.
reason: Say where the two sources disagree, and which one sets the higher level for railroad benefits.

value: International certification (the scope chart also accepts Puerto Rico); Basic and Advanced are not enough.
reason: Publication 4491 and Publication 4012 Tab D name International only; only the scope chart adds Puerto Rico, so the card should not state Puerto Rico as settled.

value: Publication 4491 refers these taxpayers to an International-certified volunteer or a professional preparer; Publication 4012's scope chart also names Puerto Rico certification.
reason: Give the reason for the wording: the sources differ on Puerto Rico.

value: No Form 1116: Basic. Form 1116 required: International certification (the scope chart also accepts Puerto Rico).
reason: Same disagreement as ftc-1116: International is the level every source names.

value: When they are to a Roth IRA or a 401(k); deductible traditional IRA contributions need Advanced, and nondeductible ones are out of scope.
reason: "Otherwise Advanced" wrongly includes nondeductible traditional IRA contributions, which the scope chart puts out of scope.

value: The intake sheet codes the item (B/A) because the level depends on the account; Publication 4012's scope chart splits traditional IRA contributions into deductible and nondeductible.
reason: Point to the scope chart row that supports the new back.

value: Publication 4491-X (Rev. 1-2026), VITA/TCE Training Supplement, “2025 Publication 4491, page xii: Child Tax Credit/Additional Child Tax Credit”, PDF p. 36
reason: The $1,400-to-$1,700 correction to Publication 4491 is listed on PDF p. 36; the cited p. 16 is Pub 4012 page G-6, which the supplement marks “No changes”.
Cite the page that holds the correction.

value: Under heading Child Tax Credit/Additional Child Tax Credit, in the first sentence, replace, $1,400, with:
One current-year Form 13614-C for each prior-year return.
reason: The cited Pub 4491 p. 347 does not say volunteers refer to that year's revision of the form (that is Pub 5838 p. 6).

value: A Military-certified volunteer, for an active duty taxpayer only; a home rented for under 15 days is not a rental activity.
reason: "Only Military" ignores the Advanced row on the same page for a personal residence rented under 15 days.

value: They form one checklist item, after the credits and Affordable Care Act items and before the banking details.
reason: The Affordable Care Act item sits between credits and payments on the checklist.
